tianxia.talent.shadow.shadow_signal.why: Projects a simple silhouette (a warning symbol, an arrow, a written message, a map-like outline) onto a visible surface for 10 minutes at up to a mile: signalling, not a fight effect.

tianxia.talent.blood.physician_s_pulse.why: An Action and 1 CP to touch one willing creature and learn what ails it. The table reports ordinary bleeding, poison, disease and ordinary exhaustion from the creature's own conditions. It cannot see internal injury, foreign bloodline contamination, or an obvious bodily curse or transformation, and it removes nothing.

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.pulse_dia.why: A Wisdom (Medicine) check against a GM-set DC on a willing, Incapacitated, Restrained, Grappled or unaware creature that learns two facts about it (or one on a failure): GM information, no fight effect of its own.

THREAD_BASE_SPOOL_AND_STRAND.why: Lets the Thread user prepare, draw and conceal strands and make Qi Thread for 1 CP; it 'enables your Thread talents' and by itself 'does not restrain creatures, deal damage, or create traps' -- each Thread talent is typed on its own.

FLOWERS_BASE_FRAGRANCE.why: The frame for the Fragrance talents: a drifting fragrance in a 15-foot sphere (Concentration, 1 minute) to which 'one Fragrance talent you know' is applied. It has no effect of its own; the effect is each Fragrance talent's, typed on its own.

foundation.glass_heart_meridian_v0_2A.re.why: Only says when a Glass Heart technique counts as Foundation-aligned: it 'must actually risk or express vulnerability, truth, repair, or refusal of false image' and pure glamour, vanity or image management does not qualify. That is the GM's reading of the technique; the row itself generates no resource and grants no effect.

TAL_WAX_FUNERAL_CANDLE_SHELTER.why: Rider lane C11 (2026-09-30): a death handler of combat/ext/life_state.py -- when a creature the owner can see within 60 feet would die from damage under the Dying rules, the owner is asked; its Reaction and 5 CP keep the creature at 0 Hit Points, Stable, once per fight (combat/ext/wax_candle.py). Shelter the Departing Trace stays the GM's.

TAL_BARRAGE_QUICK_DRAW_ARSENAL.why: Once per turn, draw a thrown weapon, ammunition, quiver, case, sling stone, needle bundle or comparable container without spending an Action, and stow one ranged or thrown weapon at the same time. This table charges no Action for drawing or stowing: a fighter's weapons and thrown weapons are always ready to attack with, so the text gives nothing further to run.
